title: I got tired of all the ads for the simple games I play, so I made them myself.
author: ai_helps
selftext: I am a developer in business applications, and I use AI all day, generative and agentic.  For games, I use Claude for my prompts and Google AI Studio to build it.  Free level.  If I run out of tokens, I wait a day.  Then like any development I literate.  Now I have my simple games like putting puzzles together and color by numbers, TPS, and others I made that I've always had in my head.  If you are tired of ads, make it yourself.  Good learning experience and pipeline development.  It's the groundwork for more complex games.  It's fun.
